# Franz Mensch

> > Franz Mensch is a B2B supplier specializing in hygiene articles, occupational safety equipment, and eco-friendly packaging solutions for professional use.

Franz Mensch offers comprehensive product lines including Hygostar protective gloves, Naturestar eco-friendly packaging, Only Paper sustainable solutions, and Allfood food service products. The company serves businesses across food service, healthcare, and industrial sectors with quality hygiene and safety products.
